def test_truncate_returns_original_when_max_length_is_none():

    assert truncate(value, len(value) + 1) == value


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("value", "max_length", "expected"),
    [
        ("abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz", 7, "ab...yz"),
        ("abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz", 8, "ab...xyz"),
    ],
)
def test_truncate_preserves_ends_when_string_exceeds_max_length(
    value, max_length, expected

    assert len(result) == max_length
